description: Shared Renovate preset for every ostendorf-cloud repository: semantic commits, signed-off commits, pinned digests, the dependencies label, and a release-age floor for npm packages.

packageRules.description: First party workflow references and the preset reference stay on a floating tag such as v0, never a digest pin and never a bump to an exact tag.

Renovate itself ships a patch release almost every day. A pull request for it is proposed once a week, so its checks can finish and it can merge before the next version is out. Covers the npm manager and the mise manager, which names the dependency npm:renovate with the package name renovate.
An action or reusable workflow release waits three days, so a compromised release has time to be noticed. A backdated tag passes at once. Container and service images get no floor.
The first party workflow reference stays on its floating tag and needs no release age floor.
